description: This file defines a React functional component named CreditBreakdownModal that renders a modal dialog displaying a detailed breakdown of credits and minutes per project. It imports React, a Modal component, and a utility function for rendering credits with USD formatting. The component is designed for use within a larger React application, providing a user interface element for viewing credit data.

methods.name: CreditBreakdownModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal with a table showing project credit breakdown, including project name, total credits, and total minutes.
